evidence.text: TDSB offers a street-number and street-name lookup for schools serving a residential address for regular programs. App implementation note: this prototype queries the official finder on explicit address-form submission and displays returned schools and board notes. The finder has no school-year selector; the requested school year and individual admission eligibility are not verified by this lookup. Distance, postal code or manually selecting a pilot profile does not establish school assignment. Address queries are not sent to the language model.
evidence.title: TDSB address finder — curated summary

evidence.text: EQAO reports assessment results; these are different from an overall school rating. Use the school name and address to find the correct school and review the assessment year and grade. Numeric results for the pilot schools have not been verified in this corpus.
evidence.title: EQAO school results lookup — curated guidance

evidence.text: Fraser publishes third-party academic ratings, separate from official EQAO results. Reviewed numeric scores are stored by verified TDSB school identifier in the app rating directory. School rating questions use that directory with assessment year and report edition. An unverified school remains unknown; a rating is not an overall judgment of school quality.
evidence.title: Fraser school ratings — curated publisher guidance
